faq.question: Why does Meliodas look so young?
faq.answer: Meliodas's youthful appearance is part of the curse placed on him by his father, the Demon King. He was cursed with eternal life, meaning he doesn't age. Additionally, demons in the Seven Deadly Sins universe age differently than humans.

name: Asta
description: Asta is the loud, determined protagonist of Black Clover, an orphan born without any magic in a world where magic is everything. In the Clover Kingdom, every person is born with the ability to use magic, making Asta's complete lack of magical power an unprecedented anomaly. Despite this seemingly insurmountable disadvantage, Asta's dream is to become the Wizard King — the highest authority in the kingdom. His persistence, physical strength, and unwavering spirit eventually lead him to receive a five-leaf clover grimoire containing anti-magic swords — weapons that can nullify any magic they touch. This makes Asta uniquely suited to fight against powerful mages, turning his greatest weakness into his greatest strength. Asta's character draws obvious comparisons to Naruto, but his specific brand of determination — trained through years of physical conditioning to compensate for his lack of magic — gives him a distinct identity. His membership in the Black Bulls, the worst-ranked Magic Knight squad, provides him with a found family of misfits and outcasts who each have their own compelling stories. Asta's anti-magic powers evolve throughout the series, eventually allowing him to access a Devil Union form that combines his physical prowess with the anti-magic devil Liebe's power. While some viewers find his constant yelling in early episodes off-putting, Asta's genuine heart and incredible fight scenes have earned him a dedicated and passionate fanbase.

faq.question: Is Asta just a copy of Naruto?
faq.answer: While Asta shares surface-level similarities with Naruto (underdog dreaming of becoming the top leader), his story diverges significantly. Asta's anti-magic abilities create unique tactical situations, and the Black Clover world's magic system offers different narrative possibilities than Naruto's chakra system.

name: Senku Ishigami
description: Senku Ishigami is the genius protagonist of Dr. Stone, a high school student with an encyclopedic knowledge of science who is petrified along with all of humanity by a mysterious flash of light. After breaking free from his stone prison 3,700 years later, Senku declares his mission to rebuild civilization from scratch using science. What makes Senku unique among shonen protagonists is that his power isn't physical — it's intellectual. He defeats challenges not through fighting but through scientific knowledge, recreating everything from antibiotics to cell phones to space rockets using Stone Age resources. His catchphrase 'Ten billion percent' reflects his absolute confidence in science, and his character serves as a love letter to the scientific method and human ingenuity. Senku's relationship with his adoptive father Byakuya, an astronaut who prepared for Senku's eventual revival from space, adds genuine emotional depth to what could have been a purely cerebral show. His rivalry with Tsukasa, who wants to create a world without the corrupt adults of the old world, raises thought-provoking questions about whether civilization's technological progress is worth preserving. Dr. Stone's celebration of science, cooperation, and the cumulative achievement of human knowledge makes Senku one of the most refreshingly positive protagonists in modern anime.

faq.question: Is the science in Dr. Stone accurate?
faq.answer: The science in Dr. Stone is largely accurate and well-researched. Author Riichiro Inagaki works with scientific advisor KURARE to ensure the inventions and chemical processes shown are based on real science, though some timelines are compressed for storytelling.

name: Power
description: Power is the self-proclaimed 'Blood Fiend' and one of the main characters of Chainsaw Man, a series known for its brutal action and subversive storytelling. As a Fiend — a devil who has taken over a human corpse — Power retains her devil consciousness while inhabiting a human body, complete with her distinctive horns. Power's personality is a chaotic blend of arrogance, cowardice, compulsive lying, and a childlike selfishness that makes her simultaneously infuriating and endearing. She claims to be the strongest devil hunter while frequently running away from actual threats, eats others' food without remorse, and rarely bathes. Yet beneath her obnoxious exterior lies a character capable of genuine affection, most notably for her pet cat Meowy and eventually for her teammate Denji. Her Blood Devil abilities allow her to manipulate blood into weapons, create blood clones, and control the blood within her body for enhanced healing and combat. Power's character arc in Chainsaw Man is particularly devastating — she grows from a self-serving creature who sees humans as inferior to someone who genuinely cares about her friends, making her eventual fate all the more heartbreaking. Her dynamic with Denji is one of the series' highlights, evolving from mutual annoyance to a sibling-like bond that defies the typical romantic pairing expectations of the genre. Author Tatsuki Fujimoto uses Power to explore themes of found family and what it means to truly care about someone.

name: Denji
description: Denji is the protagonist of Chainsaw Man and one of the most unconventional shonen heroes in anime history. Unlike typical protagonists driven by grand ambitions, Denji's goals are heartbreakingly simple — he wants to eat good food, have a girlfriend, and live a normal life. Growing up in crushing poverty, forced to work as a devil hunter to pay off his dead father's debts to the yakuza, Denji never had the luxury of dreaming big. When his pet devil Pochita (the Chainsaw Devil) sacrifices himself to save Denji's life by becoming his heart, Denji gains the ability to transform into the Chainsaw Man — a hybrid devil who can sprout chainsaws from his body. Author Tatsuki Fujimoto uses Denji's character to deconstruct the entire shonen genre. Where other protagonists fight for justice or to protect others, Denji fights because his government handler Makima tells him to, driven by his crush on her and his desire for the basic comforts he's never known. This makes his eventual realization that he's been manipulated all the more devastating. Denji's journey is ultimately about learning what it means to truly live versus merely surviving, and about distinguishing genuine love from manipulation. His crude, simple personality masks a deeply lonely person who desperately wants human connection, making him far more complex than he initially appears.

faq.question: Is Chainsaw Man a shonen or seinen?
faq.answer: Part 1 of Chainsaw Man was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump (shonen magazine), while Part 2 moved to Shonen Jump+ (which publishes more mature content). The series is technically shonen but contains significant violence and mature themes that appeal to a seinen audience.

name: Ryomen Sukuna
description: Ryomen Sukuna is the King of Curses and the primary antagonist of Jujutsu Kaisen. Over a thousand years ago, Sukuna was a human sorcerer of such overwhelming power that after his death, his cursed energy was too great to be destroyed, and his twenty fingers became indestructible cursed objects scattered across Japan. When protagonist Yuji Itadori consumes one of these fingers, Sukuna is reborn within him, setting up the central conflict of the series. Sukuna is not simply a powerful villain — he is an absolute force of nature. His Cursed Technique, Cleave and Dismantle, can slice through virtually anything, adjusting its power based on the target's toughness. His Domain Expansion, Malevolent Shrine, is unique in that it doesn't create a barrier but instead manifests in the real world, reflecting his immense confidence and power. Sukuna's fight against Gojo Satoru, the strongest sorcerer of the modern era, is a landmark event in manga and anime, showcasing two titans pushing each other beyond their limits. What makes Sukuna compelling as a villain is his genuine enjoyment of strong opponents and his total lack of interest in anything he deems beneath him. He's not motivated by world domination or revenge — he simply exists as the apex predator of the cursed world, and he revels in it. His charisma, intelligence, and the sheer spectacle of his power have made him one of the most popular villains in modern anime.

faq.question: Is Sukuna stronger than Gojo?
faq.answer: In their climactic battle, Sukuna ultimately defeats Gojo, though Gojo pushed him to his absolute limits. The fight is considered extremely close, with both fighters using everything in their arsenal. The general consensus is they are roughly equal, with Sukuna winning due to tactical advantages.

faq.question: Why does Sukuna have four arms?
faq.answer: In his original form, Sukuna is described as having four arms and two faces. The name 'Ryomen Sukuna' literally means 'Two-Faced Sukuna,' referencing a legendary figure in Japanese mythology with multiple faces and limbs.

name: Makima
description: Makima is the main antagonist of Chainsaw Man Part 1 and one of the most terrifying villains in modern anime. Initially presented as Denji's kind and caring government handler — the beautiful woman who rescues him from his miserable life and gives him a purpose — Makima is eventually revealed to be the Control Devil, an immensely powerful devil embodying the concept of control and domination. Her true nature makes her one of the most feared beings in the Chainsaw Man universe. Makima's genius lies in author Tatsuki Fujimoto's masterful use of audience expectations. She appears to be the mentor figure, the love interest, the competent leader — all tropes that manga readers trust. The slow revelation of her true manipulative nature recontextualizes every earlier scene, revealing that she was controlling and orchestrating events from the very beginning. Her ability to dominate any being she considers beneath her, combined with her contract with the Japanese Prime Minister (which deflects any fatal injury to a random Japanese citizen), makes her nearly impossible to defeat. Makima's goal is to use the Chainsaw Devil's power of erasure to eliminate concepts she deems harmful — death, war, famine — to create her ideal world. While her goals might seem noble on the surface, her methods involve complete subjugation of free will, making her a villain who is genuinely terrifying because she represents the seductive allure of giving up your freedom for comfort and security.

faq.question: Is Makima evil?
faq.answer: Makima's morality is complex. Her goal to erase concepts like war and death could be seen as noble, but her methods involve complete domination of free will. She manipulates and kills without remorse, uses people as tools, and views relationships as forms of ownership rather than genuine connection.

faq.question: How is Makima defeated?
faq.answer: Denji realizes that Makima can only control beings she views as 'beneath her,' so he defeats her not through combat but through consuming her remains with love rather than fear or hate — emotions she can't control. This allows the Control Devil to be reborn as Nayuta, free from Makima's personality.

name: Frieza
description: Frieza is the most iconic villain in Dragon Ball and one of the greatest antagonists in anime history. As the emperor of Universe 7 and the tyrannical ruler of a galactic empire, Frieza is responsible for some of the most devastating events in the Dragon Ball timeline, including the genocide of the Saiyan race by destroying Planet Vegeta. His confrontation with Goku on Planet Namek is the defining arc of Dragon Ball Z, culminating in Goku's first Super Saiyan transformation — one of the most legendary moments in anime. Frieza's character design is masterful — his multiple transformation forms, each more terrifying than the last, create escalating tension throughout the Namek saga. His final form's sleek, simple design contrasts sharply with his overwhelming power, making him all the more unsettling. Frieza is characterized by his aristocratic mannerisms, sadistic wit, and casual cruelty. He speaks politely while torturing opponents, treats genocide as a minor inconvenience, and maintains an air of superiority even when outmatched. His return in Dragon Ball Super's Resurrection F arc introduced Golden Frieza, and his further evolution to Black Frieza in the manga has kept him relevant as one of the strongest beings in the multiverse. Despite being pure evil, Frieza's charm, intelligence, and memorable quotes have made him a fan-favorite character for decades.

faq.question: How strong is Black Frieza?
faq.answer: Black Frieza is shown to be powerful enough to one-shot both Goku in Ultra Instinct and Vegeta in Ultra Ego simultaneously. This makes him arguably the strongest mortal in Universe 7, surpassing even the protagonists at their peak.

faq.question: Why did Frieza destroy Planet Vegeta?
faq.answer: Frieza destroyed Planet Vegeta because he feared the legend of the Super Saiyan — a warrior who could challenge his power. He also saw the Saiyans as potential threats due to their ability to grow stronger after each battle.

name: Natsu Dragneel
description: Natsu Dragneel is the fiery protagonist of Fairy Tail and a member of the eponymous wizard guild. Raised by the fire dragon Igneel, Natsu is a Fire Dragon Slayer — a mage who uses dragon-taught magic to wield and consume fire. His insatiable appetite for destruction, unwavering loyalty to his guild, and infectious enthusiasm make him the heart of the Fairy Tail guild. Natsu's past is far more complex than it appears — he's actually Zeref's younger brother who died 400 years ago and was revived as the Etherious demon END (Etherious Natsu Dragneel). He was sent forward in time through the Eclipse Gate to defeat the dragon Acnologia. Despite these dark origins, Natsu remains one of anime's most purely optimistic protagonists. His power increases dramatically in critical moments, typically when his friends are threatened, leading to spectacular but often criticized 'power of friendship' victories. His Dragon Force form and later the Fire Dragon King mode represent his highest power levels, capable of defeating some of the most powerful enemies in the Fairy Tail universe. Natsu's relationship with Lucy Heartfilia provides the series' romantic subplot, while his rivalry with Gray Fullbuster adds comic relief and competitive motivation. Though Fairy Tail is sometimes criticized for formulaic storytelling, Natsu's charming personality and exciting fire-based combat have made him a beloved character in the broader shonen landscape.

faq.question: What is Natsu's true identity?
faq.answer: Natsu is actually Zeref's younger brother who died 400 years ago. Zeref revived him as the Etherious demon END (Etherious Natsu Dragneel) and sent him forward through time via the Eclipse Gate to eventually be raised by the dragon Igneel.

faq.question: Can Natsu eat his own fire?
faq.answer: Natsu cannot eat fire that he himself creates. However, he can eat virtually any other fire, including magical fire from other sources, to restore his energy and increase his power. He has also consumed other elements like lightning and even Godslayer flames.

name: Ichigo Kurosaki
description: Ichigo Kurosaki is the protagonist of Bleach and one of the most uniquely powerful characters in anime history, being a hybrid of four different spiritual races: Human, Shinigami (Soul Reaper), Hollow, and Quincy. When the Shinigami Rukia Kuchiki transfers her powers to Ichigo to save his family from a Hollow attack, it sets him on a path that will shake the very foundations of Soul Society. Ichigo's journey from a substitute Soul Reaper to one of the most powerful beings in the Bleach universe is marked by constant escalation and incredible battle sequences. His signature move, Getsuga Tensho, is a crescent-shaped energy blast fired from his massive sword Zangetsu, and it evolves dramatically throughout the series. What makes Ichigo compelling is his fundamental motivation — he fights not for glory or revenge, but simply to protect those he cares about. His desire to shield his friends and family from harm drives every transformation and power-up he achieves. The revelation that his inner Hollow and his Zanpakuto spirit are manifestations of his complex heritage adds layers of depth to his character. His Thousand-Year Blood War arc, where he finally accepts all aspects of his heritage and gains his true Bankai, represents the culmination of his character growth. Ichigo's iconic orange hair, black Shinigami robes, and oversized zanpakuto have made him one of the most recognizable anime protagonists worldwide.

faq.question: What is Ichigo's true power?
faq.answer: Ichigo is a hybrid of four races: Human (from his body), Shinigami (from his father Isshin), Hollow (from White, the hollow that attacked his mother), and Quincy (from his mother Masaki). His True Zangetsu represents the harmony of all these powers.

faq.question: Why does Ichigo have orange hair?
faq.answer: In the series, Ichigo's orange hair is natural and has been a source of teasing throughout his life. From a design perspective, creator Tite Kubo gave him orange hair to make him stand out visually and to contrast with the typical black-haired Japanese protagonist.

name: Anya Forger
japaneseName: アーニャ・フォージャー
description: Anya Forger is the adorable telepathic child at the center of Spy x Family, a series about a spy, an assassin, and a telepath who form a fake family, each hiding their true identity from the others. Created in a secret government lab as part of an experiment to develop human telepathy, Anya escaped and went through multiple foster families before being adopted by the spy Twilight (Loid Forger). Her ability to read minds makes her the only character who knows everyone's secrets — she knows her father is a spy and her mother is an assassin — and she finds it all incredibly exciting rather than frightening. Anya's reactions to the dangerous situations around her, combined with her childlike misunderstandings and exaggerated facial expressions, have made her one of the most meme-worthy and beloved characters in recent anime history. Despite her telepathic abilities, Anya is still just a child — she struggles with schoolwork (especially spelling), gets scared easily, and desperately wants her parents to love her even though their family is supposed to be fake. The irony and comedy of the series come from Anya knowing everyone's secrets while her parents remain oblivious to each other's and Anya's true natures. Her innocent desire to keep her family together, combined with her hilarious attempts to act natural while reading minds, creates a perfect blend of comedy and heartwarming moments. Anya's 'waku waku' (excited/thrilled) catchphrase has become a cultural phenomenon.

faq.question: How old is Anya really?
faq.answer: Anya claims to be 6 years old to meet the enrollment age for Eden Academy, but she is actually 4 or 5. She lied about her age because she overheard (via telepathy) that Loid needed a child of school age.

faq.question: What does 'waku waku' mean?
faq.answer: Waku waku (ワクワク) is a Japanese onomatopoeia that expresses excitement and anticipation. It's become Anya's signature catchphrase, used whenever she encounters something thrilling.

faq.question: Can Anya control her telepathy?
faq.answer: Anya cannot fully control her telepathy. It activates when people are nearby, and she sometimes gets overwhelmed by too many thoughts at once. She can focus on specific people, but she can't turn it off entirely.

name: Satoru Fujinuma
description: Satoru Fujinuma is the protagonist of Erased (Boku dake ga Inai Machi), a young manga artist who possesses an involuntary ability called Revival — a mysterious power that sends him back in time moments before a life-threatening incident occurs, giving him a chance to prevent tragedy. When his mother is murdered and he's framed for the crime, Revival sends him not just minutes but eighteen years into the past, back to when he was an elementary school student in 1988. There, he realizes that his mother's murder is connected to the abduction and killing of his classmate Kayo Hinazuki, and he sets out to save her and change the future. Satoru's character is compelling because of the contrast between his adult mind and his child body — he approaches the mystery with adult understanding while navigating the social dynamics of elementary school. His growing determination to save Kayo, whose home life involves severe abuse from her mother, drives some of the most emotionally powerful scenes in the series. The iconic breakfast scene, where Kayo is moved to tears by a simple home-cooked meal, is considered one of the most touching moments in anime. Satoru represents the universal wish to go back and fix our regrets, and his willingness to sacrifice everything to save others makes him a quietly heroic protagonist in a genre that usually favors flashier characters.

faq.question: How does Revival work?
faq.answer: Revival is an involuntary ability that activates when someone nearby is about to die or be seriously harmed. It typically sends Satoru back 1-5 minutes, but in extreme cases, it sent him back 18 years. Satoru cannot control when it activates.

faq.question: Is Erased based on a true story?
faq.answer: No, Erased is a fictional manga by Kei Sanbe. However, the themes of child abuse and abduction reflect real social issues in Japan, and the 1988 setting evokes the atmosphere of that era.

name: All Might (Toshinori Yagi)
description: All Might, real name Toshinori Yagi, is the Symbol of Peace and the most iconic hero in My Hero Academia's world. The former Number One Hero and eighth wielder of One For All, All Might maintained peace and order through his overwhelming strength and his signature smile — a symbol of hope that assured everyone that everything would be alright. His famous catchphrase 'I am here!' became a rallying cry that suppressed crime rates across Japan simply through the assurance of his presence. However, behind the towering, muscular hero form lies a devastating secret: All Might was gravely injured five years before the story begins, losing most of his stomach in a battle with the villain All For One. In his true form, he's a gaunt, skeletal figure who coughs up blood and can only maintain his hero form for increasingly limited periods. This duality between the public Symbol of Peace and the privately suffering Toshinori is one of the most compelling aspects of his character. All Might's decision to pass One For All to Midoriya — seeing in the quirkless boy the same heroic spirit that his own mentor saw in him — is the catalyst for the entire series. His final battle against All For One in Kamino Ward, where he uses the last embers of One For All to deliver one final 'United States of Smash,' is one of the most emotional and triumphant moments in anime. The torch-passing from All Might to Deku represents the series' central theme: that the next generation will always surpass the previous one.

faq.question: Why did All Might choose Deku?
faq.answer: All Might chose Midoriya because he saw in him the same heroic instinct that defines a true hero — the ability to act before thinking when someone is in danger. When Midoriya rushed to save Bakugo from the Sludge Villain despite being Quirkless, All Might recognized the spirit of a true hero.

faq.question: Can All Might still fight?
faq.answer: After using the last remnants of One For All against All For One in Kamino Ward, All Might lost all of his powers permanently. He can no longer maintain his muscle form or use any enhanced abilities, and serves only as a teacher and mentor.

name: Gaara
description: Gaara is the Fifth Kazekage of Sunagakure and was introduced as a major antagonist during the Chunin Exams. Born as the Jinchuriki of the One-Tailed Shukaku, Gaara was feared and hated by his village. His father attempted to assassinate him multiple times, leading Gaara to believe that his only purpose was to love himself and kill anyone who threatened his existence. This dark mindset was shattered when he fought Naruto Uzumaki, who shared his pain as a fellow outcast but chose a different path. Naruto's kindness and willingness to protect his friends inspired Gaara to change. He subsequently resolved to become the Kazekage so he could protect his village and be acknowledged by others. Gaara is known for his ultimate defense, using sand stored in his gourd to shield himself automatically. His sand control is absolute, allowing him to create sandstorms, levitate, and crush opponents with sand burial techniques.

faq.question: Why does Gaara have 'love' on his forehead?
faq.answer: The kanji on Gaara's forehead represents 'love' (Ai). After his uncle Yashamaru tried to kill him and told him that his mother hated him, Gaara used sand to carve the symbol on his forehead to symbolize a demon who loves only himself.

faq.question: Does Gaara lose his powers after Shukaku is extracted?
faq.answer: No. Although Shukaku is extracted by the Akatsuki, Gaara retains his sand control abilities, which were actually a gift from his mother's spirit, not Shukaku.

name: Madara Uchiha
description: Madara Uchiha was the legendary leader of the Uchiha clan who co-founded Konohagakure alongside his rival Hashirama Senju. Driven by the desire to protect his clan and bring world peace on his own terms, Madara became disillusioned with the village structure. He defected and fought Hashirama in a fateful battle at the Valley of the End. Madara survived and spent his remaining years orchestrating the Infinite Tsukuyomi plan — a massive genjutsu that would trap the entire world in an endless dream world free of conflict. Reanimated during the Fourth Great Ninja War, Madara demonstrated overwhelming power, single-handedly wiping out the Allied Shinobi Forces and capturing the tailed beasts. He eventually became the Ten-Tails' Jinchuriki, achieving god-level status before being betrayed by Black Zetsu. Madara is widely regarded as one of the most imposing and iconic villains in shonen anime history.

faq.question: How did Madara awaken the Rinnegan?
faq.answer: Madara awakened the Rinnegan by mixing the cells of Hashirama Senju (Ashura's reincarnate) with his own (Indra's reincarnate), combining their chakra to recreate Hagoromo Otsutsuki's chakra. The Rinnegan awakened near the end of his natural life.

faq.question: Why did Black Zetsu betray Madara?
faq.answer: Black Zetsu betrayed Madara because Madara's Infinite Tsukuyomi plan was actually a trap engineered by Zetsu to revive his mother, Kaguya Otsutsuki. Madara was merely a vessel used to bring Kaguya back.

name: Obito Uchiha
description: Obito Uchiha was a ninja from Konohagakure who was believed to have died during the Third Shinobi World War. He gave his Sharingan to his teammate Kakashi Hatake before being crushed by a boulder. Saved by an elderly Madara Uchiha, Obito witnessed the death of his beloved teammate Rin Nohara at the hands of Kakashi. This tragedy broke his spirit and led him to adopt Madara's ideology that the real world is a hell that needs to be replaced by a dream world. Operating under the aliases Tobi and Madara, Obito manipulated the Akatsuki from the shadows, declared the Fourth Great Ninja War, and became the Ten-Tails' Jinchuriki. Naruto eventually convinced him to redeem himself, and Obito sacrificed his life to save Team 7 and defeat Kaguya Otsutsuki, dying with his childhood dream of becoming Hokage renewed in his heart.

faq.question: Why did Obito help Madara?
faq.answer: Obito helped Madara because Rin's death convinced him that the world was beyond saving and that the Infinite Tsukuyomi was the only way to create a world where Rin could live happily.

faq.question: How does Kamui work?
faq.answer: Obito's Kamui allows him to transfer parts of his body to a pocket dimension, making him appear intangible. He can maintain intangibility for up to five minutes continuously.

name: Tsunade
description: Tsunade is one of Konohagakure's Legendary Sannin alongside Jiraiya and Orochimaru. She is widely regarded as the world's strongest medical ninja and most powerful kunoichi. Devastated by the deaths of her younger brother Nawaki and lover Dan Kato during the war, Tsunade developed a severe phobia of blood and abandoned the ninja life, spending decades gambling. She was eventually tracked down by Naruto and Jiraiya after the Third Hokage's death. Naruto's determination inspired her to overcome her trauma and accept the position of Fifth Hokage. Tsunade is known for her monstrous strength, chakra control, and the creation of the Strength of a Hundred Seal, which allows her to instantly heal any injury without using hand seals.
