faq.question: Why does Tsunade look so young?
faq.answer: Tsunade uses a transformation technique powered by her constant chakra control to maintain the appearance of a woman in her twenties, despite being in her mid-fifties.

faq.question: How did Tsunade get her nickname 'The Legendary Loser'?
faq.answer: Tsunade has an absolute lack of luck in gambling, leading to her nickname. Her rare winning streaks are actually viewed as bad omens of upcoming tragedies.

name: Orochimaru
description: Orochimaru is one of Konoha's Legendary Sannin who turned villainous in his quest for immortality and knowledge of all jutsu. After witnessing the death of his teammates' loved ones, Orochimaru developed a fear of mortality and began conducting unethical human experiments. Caught and banished by the Third Hokage, he founded Otogakure (Hidden Sound Village) and sought to destroy Konoha, successfully killing his former master. Orochimaru is obsessed with the Uchiha clan's Sharingan, leading him to recruit and train Sasuke Uchiha as his next host body. Orochimaru is a master of snake-themed jutsu, forbidden reanimation techniques, and body modification, allowing him to survive almost any fatal injury.

abilities.name: Reanimation Jutsu
abilities.description: A forbidden jutsu that binds the souls of the deceased to living sacrifices, bringing them back under his control.

abilities.name: Eight Branches Technique
abilities.description: Transforms Orochimaru into a giant eight-headed snake with immense destructive power.

abilities.name: Living Corpse Reincarnation
abilities.description: Transfers his soul into another host's body to extend his lifespan indefinitely.

transformations.name: Base Form
transformations.description: Pale skin, purple eye markings, and sound village outfit.

transformations.name: White Snake Form
transformations.description: His true form, a massive white snake composed of smaller snakes.

faq.question: Does Orochimaru die in Naruto?
faq.answer: Orochimaru is absorbed by Sasuke and sealed by Itachi's Totsuka Blade, but he survives through curse marks and is revived by Sasuke during the Fourth Great Ninja War using Anko's curse mark.

faq.question: Why is Orochimaru good in Boruto?
faq.answer: After the war, Orochimaru reached a truce with Konoha, choosing to observe history and conduct experiments peacefully under Konoha's surveillance. He created Mitsuki as a synthetic son.

name: Shikamaru Nara
description: Shikamaru Nara is a ninja from Team 10 known for his lazy attitude and brilliant IQ exceeding 200. Despite finding ninja missions 'troublesome,' Shikamaru is a master strategist who uses the Nara clan's Shadow Imitation Jutsu to trap and manipulate enemies. His intelligence was recognized early, making him the only genin promoted to chunin during the exams. The death of his mentor Asuma Sarutobi forced Shikamaru to grow up, leading him to defeat the immortal Akatsuki member Hidan using a complex, multi-layered plan. Shikamaru eventually becomes Naruto's advisor and right-hand man when Naruto becomes Hokage, serving as the strategic brain of the village.

abilities.name: Shadow Imitation Jutsu
abilities.description: Extends his shadow to merge with an opponent's shadow, forcing them to mimic his movements.

abilities.name: Shadow Strangle Jutsu
abilities.description: Climbs up the target's body as shadow hands to physically choke them.

abilities.name: Shadow Stitching Jutsu
abilities.description: Materializes shadows into sharp spikes that pierce and pin opponents down.

transformations.name: Base Form
transformations.description: Spiky ponytail, mesh armor, and Nara clan earrings.

faq.question: How smart is Shikamaru?
faq.answer: Shikamaru has an IQ of over 200, which Asuma discovered by giving him a series of strategic puzzles. He can formulate dozens of moves ahead and analyze opponents' abilities in seconds.

faq.question: Who does Shikamaru marry?
faq.answer: Shikamaru marries Temari, a sand ninja and Gaara's sister. Their relationship starts as a rivalry during the Chunin Exams and slowly develops into romance over several years.

name: Minato Namikaze
description: Minato Namikaze, known as the 'Yellow Flash of the Leaf,' was the Fourth Hokage of Konohagakure and the father of Naruto Uzumaki. He was renowned for his unmatched speed, mastering the Flying Raijin Jutsu to teleport instantly between marked locations. During the Third Shinobi World War, enemy villages ordered a 'flee-on-sight' directive for Minato. When the Nine-Tails attacked Konoha under Obito's control, Minato defeated the masked man and sacrificed his life alongside his wife, Kushina Uzumaki, sealing half of Kurama's chakra inside their newborn son, Naruto, trusting that Naruto would one day master it. Minato is also the creator of the Rasengan, which he spent three years developing.

abilities.name: Flying Raijin Jutsu
abilities.description: Teleports instantly to any location marked with his special seal, allowing for near-instantaneous movement.

abilities.name: Rasengan
abilities.description: A spinning sphere of chakra that Minato invented and perfected.

abilities.name: Reaper Death Seal
abilities.description: A sealing jutsu that summons the Shinigami to seal an opponent's soul at the cost of the user's life.

transformations.name: Base Form
transformations.description: Blonde hair with his white Hokage cloak.

transformations.name: Nine-Tails Sage Mode
transformations.description: Reanimated body with Kurama's chakra cloak and sage pigmentation.

faq.question: Why did Minato seal Kurama in Naruto?
faq.answer: Minato sealed Kurama inside Naruto because he believed his son was the 'Child of Prophecy' who would eventually save the world from the masked man (Obito), and he knew Naruto would need Kurama's power to do so.

faq.question: How did Minato get his speed?
faq.answer: Minato's speed was a combination of his incredible natural reflexes and his mastery of Tobirama Senju's Flying Raijin Jutsu, which he enhanced using marked kunai.

name: Trunks (Future)
description: Future Trunks is the half-Saiyan son of Vegeta and Bulma who traveled back in time to warn Goku and the Z-Fighters about the android threat. Born in a post-apocalyptic future where the Androids killed all the Z-Fighters, Trunks was trained by Future Gohan, whose tragic death triggered Trunks' first Super Saiyan transformation. Unlike the prideful Vegeta, Trunks is polite, cautious, and practical, wielding a sword to end fights quickly. He famously defeated Mecha Frieza and King Cold within minutes of arriving in the past. In Dragon Ball Super, he returns to the past after his timeline is threatened by Goku Black, eventually achieving Super Saiyan Rage and slicing Fused Zamasu with his Sword of Hope.

abilities.name: Burning Attack
abilities.description: Rapid hand movements that launch a powerful sphere of energy.

abilities.name: Masenko
abilities.description: A quick-draw energy blast taught to him by Future Gohan.

abilities.name: Sword of Hope
abilities.description: Gathers energy from the living beings of his timeline into his broken sword to slice opponents.

transformations.name: Base Form
transformations.description: Lavender hair, Capsule Corp jacket, carrying a broadsword.

transformations.name: Super Saiyan
transformations.description: Golden hair and golden aura.

transformations.name: Super Saiyan Grade 3
transformations.description: Monstrously bulky muscles that sacrifice speed for power.

transformations.name: Super Saiyan Anger
transformations.description: Spiky blue-golden aura and white eyes of rage.

faq.question: Why does Future Trunks have a sword?
faq.answer: In his war-torn future, Trunks used a sword as a practical weapon to defeat Androids, and it served as a symbol of his fighting spirit. In the movie, it is shown that Tapion gave him the sword, though its origin differs in canon.

faq.question: Why is Trunks' hair blue in Dragon Ball Super?
faq.answer: Toriyama changed Trunks' hair design to match Bulma's hair color, which was originally blue in the manga. The anime adapted this change starting in the Goku Black arc.

name: Bulma
description: Bulma is the longest-running female character in the Dragon Ball franchise and is responsible for starting the entire story by inventing the Dragon Radar and recruiting young Goku to search for the Dragon Balls. As the daughter of Capsule Corp's founder, Bulma is a genius scientist whose inventions — including the Dragon Radar, capsules, and time machines — have repeatedly saved the universe. Despite having no combat abilities, Bulma is headstrong, temperamental, and brave, standing up to gods and tyrants. She eventually marries Vegeta, helping soften the Saiyan prince's heart and starting a family with him.

abilities.name: Scientific Genius
abilities.description: Bulma can build time machines, space radars, and energy blasters, making her one of the smartest humans.

faq.question: How did Bulma and Vegeta get together?
faq.answer: After the Namek Saga, Vegeta stayed at Capsule Corp. Bulma showed him kindness and gave him a place to live while he trained. Their relationship developed off-screen during the three-year android preparation period.

faq.question: What is Bulma's most important invention?
faq.answer: The Dragon Radar is her most iconic invention, but the Time Machine she built in Future Trunks' timeline is her most critical, saving the universe from the Androids.

name: Krillin
description: Krillin is Goku's best friend and a fellow martial artist who trained under Master Roshi. Initially introduced as a sneaky rival, Krillin quickly became Goku's closest companion. Despite being outclassed by Saiyans and aliens as the power scale exploded, Krillin remains one of the strongest pure humans on Earth, known for his tactical thinking and his invention of the Destructo Disc. His death at the hands of Frieza on Planet Namek served as the ultimate trigger for Goku to transform into a Super Saiyan. Krillin later marries Android 18 and becomes a police officer, balancing family life with helping defend Earth when needed.

abilities.name: Destructo Disc
abilities.description: A razor-sharp disc of energy that can cut through opponents far stronger than Krillin.

abilities.name: Solar Flare
abilities.description: Releases a blinding flash of light to temporarily blind opponents.

abilities.name: Kamehameha
abilities.description: The signature energy wave taught by Master Roshi.

faq.question: Why does Krillin have six dots on his forehead?
faq.answer: The six dots are moxibustion scars from his early training as a Buddhist monk at the Orin Temple.

faq.question: Is Krillin the strongest human?
faq.answer: Yes, Akira Toriyama has confirmed that Krillin is the strongest pure human on Earth, surpassing Tien and Yamcha.

name: Majin Buu
description: Majin Buu is a magical lifeform created by the wizard Bibidi millions of years ago, known for his pink skin, rubbery body, and immense power. Buu is highly volatile, possessing the ability to regenerate instantly from a single molecule, turn people into candy, and absorb other fighters to gain their power. The fat 'Good Buu' developed a childlike personality and befriended Hercule Satan, eventually separating from his evil half. Kid Buu, the original and most dangerous form, was an chaotic force of pure destruction who blew up Earth before being defeated by Goku's Spirit Bomb. Good Buu now lives peacefully on Earth, occasionally helping the Z-Fighters.

abilities.name: Transmutation Beam (Candy Beam)
abilities.description: Turns targets into chocolate, candy, or clay using his antenna.

abilities.name: Instant Regeneration
abilities.description: Can reform his body from steam, dust, or microscopic cells.

abilities.name: Absorption
abilities.description: Envelops fighters in his body parts to absorb their power, intelligence, and techniques.

transformations.name: Fat Buu
transformations.description: Playful, round form after absorbing the Grand Supreme Kai.

transformations.name: Super Buu
transformations.description: Tall, muscular, and evil form after absorbing Fat Buu.

transformations.name: Kid Buu
transformations.description: The original, chaotic, and small form of pure evil.

faq.question: Why is Fat Buu good?
faq.answer: Fat Buu is good because he absorbed the Grand Supreme Kai, whose pure heart and kindness diluted Buu's destructive nature, giving him a childlike personality that responded to Hercule Satan's friendship.

name: Cell
description: Cell is a bio-android created by Dr. Gero using the genetic material of the universe's greatest fighters, including Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo, and Frieza. Born in a future timeline, Cell traveled back in time to absorb Android 17 and Android 18, which allowed him to achieve his 'Perfect Form.' Cell is highly arrogant, seeking to test his limits by hosting the 'Cell Games' tournament, threatening to destroy Earth if he was not defeated. He possesses Piccolo's regeneration, Frieza's durability, and the Saiyans' ability to grow stronger after near-death experiences. He was eventually defeated by Super Saiyan 2 Gohan in a legendary Father-Son Kamehameha clash.

abilities.name: Kamehameha
abilities.description: Derived from Goku, a devastating energy wave.

abilities.name: Special Beam Cannon
abilities.description: Derived from Piccolo, a drilling laser beam.

abilities.name: Perfect Barrier
abilities.description: Generates a massive energy dome that blocks all attacks.

transformations.name: Imperfect Cell
transformations.description: Insect-like form that absorbs humans using his tail.

transformations.name: Semi-Perfect Cell
transformations.description: Bulky form achieved after absorbing Android 17.

transformations.name: Perfect Cell
transformations.description: Sleek, humanoid form achieved after absorbing Android 18.

transformations.name: Super Perfect Cell
transformations.description: Power-up with electrical aura after surviving self-destruction.

faq.question: How did Cell survive self-destruction?
faq.answer: Cell survived because a single regenerative core cell in his brain remained intact after he blew himself up. His Saiyan cells allowed him to return in a 'Super Perfect' form, stronger than before.

name: Nico Robin
description: Nico Robin, also known as the 'Devil Child,' is the archeologist of the Straw Hat Pirates and the only survivor of the island of Ohara, which was destroyed by a Buster Call. Having eaten the Hana Hana no Mi (Flower-Flower Fruit), Robin can sprout limbs from any surface. She spent twenty years on the run as an outlaw before joining Luffy's crew, initially acting as a secondary antagonist (Miss All Sunday) in Baroque Works. Robin's emotional climax came during the Enies Lobby arc, where she cried out 'I want to live!' after realizing the crew was willing to declare war on the World Government to save her. She is the only person in the world who can read the Poneglyphs, making her key to finding the One Piece.

abilities.name: Hana Hana no Mi
abilities.description: Allows her to sprout eyes, ears, and limbs on any surface, including opponents' bodies.

abilities.name: Clutch
abilities.description: Sprouts hands on an enemy's body to break their neck or spine.

abilities.name: Gigantesco Mano
abilities.description: Sprouts giant arms or legs to crush fleets or protect the ship.

transformations.name: Demonio Fleur
transformations.description: Transforms into a giant black-winged demon shape using arms.

faq.question: Why does the World Government want Robin?
faq.answer: The World Government wants Robin because she can read Poneglyphs, which record the forbidden Void Century history and describe the locations of the Ancient Weapons.

name: Tony Tony Chopper
japaneseName: トニートニー・チョッパー
description: Tony Tony Chopper is the doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates. Originally a normal reindeer with a blue nose, Chopper ate the Hito Hito no Mi (Human-Human Fruit), gaining human intelligence and the ability to speak. Trained by Dr. Hiluluk and Dr. Kureha on Drum Island, Chopper invented the 'Rumble Ball,' a drug that allows him to transform into seven distinct combat forms (Points) by altering his devil fruit wavelengths. Despite his incredible strength in 'Monster Point,' Chopper is extremely naive, easily excited, and hates being complimented (though he acts pleased). His bounty remains ridiculously low because the Marines mistake him for the crew's pet.

abilities.name: Rumble Ball Transformations
abilities.description: Modifies his Devil Fruit to shift between seven points, enhancing speed, jump, or defense.

abilities.name: Monster Point
abilities.description: A massive, powerful form activated by a Rumble Ball, granting giant beast-like strength.

transformations.name: Brain Point
transformations.description: His cute, small chibi mascot form.

transformations.name: Walk Point
transformations.description: His natural reindeer form used for running.

transformations.name: Heavy Point
transformations.description: His bulky humanoid form used for physical labor.

transformations.name: Kung Fu Point
transformations.description: Wide, circular form used for martial arts.

transformations.name: Monster Point
transformations.description: Giant, berserk form that towers over battlefields.

faq.question: Why is Chopper's bounty so low?
faq.answer: The Marines think Chopper is just the 'cotton-candy-loving pet' of the Straw Hats, completely unaware that he is the monster who defeated CP9 agents and fought Yonko commanders.

name: Usopp
description: Usopp is the sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates and is known as 'God Usopp' or the 'Sogeking' (King of Snipers). He is the son of Yasopp, a sniper in Shanks' crew. Usopp is naturally cowardly, frequently telling elaborate lies about his adventures to cover his fear. Despite his lack of physical strength, Usopp is an inventive engineer and master marksman, using a slingshot loaded with 'Pop Greens' (fast-growing hostile seeds) to control battlefields. His battle on Dressrosa earned him a massive bounty and his 'God' moniker after he awakened Observation Haki to snipe Sugar from miles away, saving the kingdom.

abilities.name: Pop Green Sniper
abilities.description: Fires aggressive botanical seeds that sprout into traps, wolves, or vines.

abilities.name: Observation Haki
abilities.description: Allows Usopp to see the aura of targets through solid walls and calculate bullet drop over miles.

transformations.name: Sogeking
transformations.description: Wears a mask and cape, adopting a heroic sniper persona.

faq.question: Why did Usopp fight Luffy in Water 7?
faq.answer: Usopp fought Luffy because he couldn't accept abandoning their damaged ship, the Going Merry, which had been given to them by his childhood friend Kaya. He felt insecure that he might similarly be abandoned if he was too weak.

name: Brook
description: Brook, also known as 'Soul King,' is the musician and secondary swordsman of the Straw Hat Pirates. He is a talking skeleton who ate the Yomi Yomi no Mi (Revive-Revive Fruit), which allowed his soul to return to his body after death. However, his soul got lost in the fog of the Florian Triangle for fifty years, and by the time he found his body, it had rotted into a skeleton. Brook is a gentleman who frequently tells 'skull jokes' about his lack of flesh and asks women to see their panties. In combat, Brook is a master fencer who infuses his blade with the cold of the underworld (Soul Solid) and can separate his soul from his body to scout or hypnotize enemies.

abilities.name: Soul Solid (Underworld Cold)
abilities.description: Coats his sword in the chill of the underworld to freeze enemies on impact.

abilities.name: Soul Parade
abilities.description: Detaches his soul from his skeleton body to fly, phase through walls, and scout.

abilities.name: Binks' Sake
abilities.description: Plays music that can put enemies to sleep or boost teammates' spirits.

faq.question: Why does Brook keep his afro?
faq.answer: Brook keeps his afro because his hair roots are strong enough to stay attached to his skull. He wants to keep it so his whale friend Laboon can recognize him when they reunite.

name: Franky
description: Franky is the shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates and is a cyborg powered by cola. Originally named Cutty Flam, he was ran over by a sea train while trying to save his mentor Tom. To survive, he rebuilt his body using scrap metal, transforming himself into a cyborg. Franky built the Straw Hats' current ship, the Thousand Sunny, using Treasure Wood Adam. He is extremely loud, emotional, and easily moved to tears, frequently posing and shouting 'SUPER!' Franky fights using heavy artillery built into his body, including arm cannons, fire-breathing, and the 'General Franky' giant robot mech.

abilities.name: Coupe de Vent
abilities.description: Compresses air in his forearms to launch a devastating wind blast powered by cola.

abilities.name: Radical Beam
abilities.description: Fires a destructive laser beam modeled after Vegapunk's technology.

transformations.name: Iron Pirate Shogun
transformations.description: Pilots the giant General Franky armored mech suit.

faq.question: Why does Franky drink cola?
faq.answer: Franky's internal reactor is designed to run on cola. Without it, he loses his energy and can't use his cyborg weapons. Other drinks change his personality.

name: Portgas D. Ace
japaneseName: ポートガス・D・エース
description: Portgas D. Ace, born Gol D. Ace, was the adopted older brother of Luffy and Sabo, and the biological son of the Pirate King Gol D. Roger. He was the commander of the Whitebeard Pirates' 2nd division, wielding the Mera Mera no Mi (Flame-Flame Fruit) to control fire. Ace hated his father Roger and looked up to Whitebeard as his true father. His capture by Blackbeard triggered the Marineford War, where Luffy and the Whitebeard Pirates launched a massive assault to rescue him. Ace died protecting Luffy from Admiral Akainu, a tragic event that served as a pivotal turning point in Luffy's life, driving him to train for two years to protect his friends.

abilities.name: Mera Mera no Mi
abilities.description: Turns his body into fire, allowing him to create and manipulate flames.

abilities.name: Fire Fist (Hiken)
abilities.description: Launches a massive fist of fire that can destroy multiple ships simultaneously.

abilities.name: Flame Commandment (Enkai)
abilities.description: Gathers flames into a giant fire sphere resembling a small sun.

faq.question: Why did Ace die?
faq.answer: Ace died protecting Luffy from Admiral Akainu's magma punch, which bypassed Ace's fire element due to magma's natural superiority over fire.

name: Trafalgar D. Water Law
japaneseName: トラファルガー・ロー
description: Trafalgar Law, known as the 'Surgeon of Death,' is the captain of the Heart Pirates and a member of the Worst Generation. He possesses the Ope Ope no Mi (Op-Op Fruit), which allows him to create a spherical light blue dome ('Room') in which he has complete control over the orientation and configuration of everything inside. Law survived a fatal childhood disease thanks to Corazon, whose death inspired Law's quest to destroy Donquixote Doflamingo. He forms a pirate alliance with Luffy's crew, helping defeat Doflamingo on Dressrosa and eventually teaming up with Eustass Kid to defeat the Yonko Big Mom on Wano.

abilities.name: Ope Ope no Mi
abilities.description: Creates a 'Room' space to slice, swap, and manipulate objects and organs freely.

abilities.name: Gamma Knife
abilities.description: An energy blade that damages the target's internal organs directly, bypassing external defense.

abilities.name: K-Room (Awakening)
abilities.description: Applies Room directly to his sword, allowing it to stretch and bypass solid matter to trigger shockwaves inside the target.

faq.question: Why is Law's Devil Fruit called the Ultimate Fruit?
faq.answer: The Ope Ope no Mi is called the Ultimate Devil Fruit because it allows a skilled doctor to perform the 'Perpetual Youth Surgery,' granting another person eternal life at the cost of the user's own life.

name: Shanks
description: Red-Haired Shanks is the captain of the Red Hair Pirates and one of the Yonko (Four Emperors) ruling the New World. He is the mentor who inspired Luffy to become a pirate, giving him his signature Straw Hat and sacrificing his left arm to save Luffy from a Sea King. Shanks was an apprentice on Roger's ship alongside Buggy. Shanks possesses no Devil Fruit powers, relying instead on his mastery of all three types of Haki, particularly Conqueror's Haki, which is powerful enough to crack wood and knock out thousands of enemies instantly. Shanks remains a mysterious figure who seeks to maintain balance in the world.

abilities.name: Conqueror's Haki Mastery
abilities.description: His haki can suppress future sight, knock out seasoned warriors, and travel miles.

abilities.name: Divine Departure (Kamusari)
abilities.description: A powerful sword slash coated in Conqueror's Haki that can defeat Worst Generation crews in one blow.

faq.question: Why did Shanks lose his arm to a weak Sea King?
faq.answer: Shanks revealed that he 'bet his arm on the new era,' suggesting he allowed the injury to happen to inspire Luffy's resolve to become a strong pirate.

name: Rukia Kuchiki
description: Rukia Kuchiki is a Shinigami (Soul Reaper) from the Soul Society who starts the story by transferring her powers to Ichigo Kurosaki to save his family. Arrested for this illegal act, Rukia is sentenced to death, triggering the Soul Society rescue arc. She eventually regains her powers and stands as Ichigo's closest friend and ally. Rukia possesses the Sode no Shirayuki (Sleeve of White Snow), considered the most beautiful ice-element Zanpakuto in the Soul Society. In the Thousand-Year Blood War, she achieves Bankai: Hakka no Togame, which can freeze everything within its radius to absolute zero, defeating Sternritter As Nödt.

abilities.name: Sode no Shirayuki
abilities.description: Fires waves of ice and creates paths of snow using various 'dances.'

abilities.name: Hakka no Togame (Bankai)
abilities.description: Extends absolute zero temperature to a wide area, instantly freezing and shattering enemies.

transformations.name: Bankai Hakka no Togame
transformations.description: Her skin, hair, and clothing turn pure white with ice lace decorations.

faq.question: Who does Rukia marry?
faq.answer: Rukia marries her childhood friend Renji Abarai. They have a daughter named Ichika Abarai at the end of the series.

name: Sosuke Aizen
description: Sosuke Aizen was the captain of the 5th Division who betrayed the Soul Society, serving as Bleach's primary antagonist for the majority of the series. Initially appearing as a kind, soft-spoken leader, Aizen faked his death and revealed a cold, manipulative mastermind who had orchestrated almost every event in Ichigo's life. He defected to Hueco Mundo to lead the Arrancar army, seeking to use the Hogyoku to break the boundary between Shinigami and Hollow and overthrow the Soul King. Aizen's Zanpakuto, Kyoka Suigetsu, can trigger Complete Hypnosis, controlling all five senses of anyone who sees its release. He is defeated by Ichigo's Final Getsuga Tensho and sealed in Muken.

abilities.name: Kyoka Suigetsu (Complete Hypnosis)
abilities.description: Hypnotizes targets completely, controlling their senses of sight, sound, smell, taste, and touch.

abilities.name: Hogyoku Fusion
abilities.description: Unites with the Hogyoku to transcend the limits of Soul Reapers, gaining endless evolution and immortality.

transformations.name: Captain Form
transformations.description: Kind appearance with glasses and haori.

transformations.name: Hogyoku Chrysalis Form
transformations.description: Wrapped in a white protective layer of Hogyoku energy.

transformations.name: Hogyoku Butterfly Form
transformations.description: Sprouts multiple hollow-like wings with eyes on them.

transformations.name: Hogyoku Demon Form
transformations.description: Feral, multiple-faced monster with immense power.

faq.question: Why did Aizen help during the Quincy War?
faq.answer: Aizen helped fight Yhwach because he despised being controlled by anyone else, and Yhwach's goal of merging the worlds clashed with Aizen's desire to rule or stand above the Soul King on his own terms.

name: Kenpachi Zaraki
description: Kenpachi Zaraki is the captain of the 11th Division in the Soul Society. Unlike other captains, Kenpachi did not know his Zanpakuto's name and did not have Bankai for most of the series, relying instead on his monstrous spiritual pressure (Reiatsu) and raw physical power. He wears an eyepatch that devours his energy to handicap himself, allowing him to enjoy fights longer. During the Quincy War, he finally learns his Zanpakuto's name, Nozarashi, and achieves Bankai, transforming into a red-skinned demon of pure destructive strength. Kenpachi lives for the joy of battle, seeking out the strongest opponents.

abilities.name: Monstrous Reiatsu
abilities.description: His raw spiritual energy is so dense it can shield him from blade strikes.

abilities.name: Nozarashi (Shikai)
abilities.description: Transforms his sword into a massive cleaver capable of cutting through meteors.

abilities.name: Unnamed Bankai
abilities.description: Turns Kenpachi into a red-skinned berserker demon with unmatched physical power.

transformations.name: Base Form (Eyepatch)
transformations.description: Wears his power-dampening eyepatch and bells in his hair.

transformations.name: Unleashed Form
transformations.description: Removes the eyepatch to release his full spiritual pressure.

transformations.name: Bankai Form
transformations.description: Skin turns red, gains horns, and loses conscious control.

faq.question: Why did Kenpachi keep his power sealed?
faq.answer: Kenpachi subconsciously sealed his own power after his childhood fight with Yachiru Unohana, fearing that if he was too strong, he would never find another opponent who could give him the thrill of a close battle.

name: Kisuke Urahara
description: Kisuke Urahara is the former captain of the 12th Division and founder of the Shinigami Research and Development Institute. Banished from the Soul Society after being framed by Aizen for hollowification experiments, Urahara runs a small shop in the human world. He acts as Ichigo's mentor, training him to unlock Shinigami powers. Urahara is an eccentric, highly intelligent scientist who wears a bucket hat and geta. He created the Hogyoku and is known for devising complex traps and seals that can defeat even god-level beings. His Bankai, Kannonbiraki Benihime Aratame, can restructure anything it touches, allowing him to heal eyes, repair bodies, or split open environments.

abilities.name: Benihime
abilities.description: Fires crimson energy blasts and nets of energy.

abilities.name: Kannonbiraki Benihime Aratame (Bankai)
abilities.description: Creates a giant woman puppet that restructures anything it touches, allowing for physical alterations.

faq.question: Why did Urahara create the Hogyoku?
faq.answer: Urahara created the Hogyoku in an attempt to break the boundary between Shinigami and Hollows to save souls from decay, unaware that Aizen was working on a similar project for darker purposes.

name: Uryu Ishida
description: Uryu Ishida is a classmate of Ichigo Kurosaki who reveals himself to be one of the last surviving Quincy — human warriors who destroy Hollows using bows made of spiritual energy. Initially introducing himself as a rival who hates Shinigami for failing to save his grandfather, Uryu eventually joins Ichigo's team as a key ally. During the Thousand-Year Blood War, he joins the Wandenreich as Yhwach's chosen successor, acting as a double agent to defeat the Quincy king. He possesses the unique 'Antithesis' letter ability, which can reverse status between two selected targets.

abilities.name: Spirit Bow (Kojaku)
abilities.description: Fires arrows composed of spiritual energy with extreme precision.

abilities.name: The Antithesis
abilities.description: Selects two targets and completely reverses anything that has occurred between them, such as transferring injuries.

transformations.name: Quincy Letzt Stil
transformations.description: Traditional form that temporarily boosts power at the cost of losing his powers.

transformations.name: Quincy Vollständig
transformations.description: Modern Quincy form with angel-like energy wings.

faq.question: Why is Uryu immune to Yhwach's Auswählen?
faq.answer: Uryu was the only mixed-blood Quincy to survive Yhwach's Auswählen selection, which killed his mother. Yhwach stated that Uryu possesses a hidden power that surpasses his own, leading him to appoint Uryu as his successor.

name: Katsuki Bakugo
description: Katsuki Bakugo is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School and the childhood friend-turned-rival of Izuku Midoriya. Possessing the 'Explosion' Quirk, Bakugo secretes nitroglycerin-like sweat from his palms and ignites it at will. He is extremely aggressive, arrogant, and competitive, driven by a desire to become the number one hero and surpass All Might. Despite his abrasive exterior, Bakugo is a tactical genius with an unyielding hero's heart, refusing to join the League of Villains when captured. His relationship with Deku slowly transforms from bullying to mutual respect, culminating in a public apology to Deku during the final war arc.

abilities.name: Explosion Quirk
abilities.description: Ignites nitroglycerin-like sweat to launch blasts, propel himself through the air, and create shockwaves.

abilities.name: Howitzer Impact
abilities.description: Spins in the air to create a fiery tornado before releasing a massive explosion.

faq.question: Why does Bakugo call Deku 'Deku'?
faq.answer: Bakugo coined the nickname 'Deku' as a play on Izuku's name, translating it to mean 'good for nothing' or 'useless' to mock Deku for being quirkless.

name: Ochaco Uraraka
description: Ochaco Uraraka, also known by her hero name Uravity, is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Her Quirk, 'Zero Gravity,' allows her to negate the gravitational pull on any object she touches with the pads of her fingers. Ochaco is warm, bubbly, and practical, choosing to become a hero to earn money and give her parents a comfortable life. She forms a close bond with Deku, sharing a mutual attraction that serves as a quiet romance thread. During the final war arc, she faces Himiko Toga, seeking to understand the villain's pain rather than simply defeating her.

abilities.name: Zero Gravity
abilities.description: Makes objects weightless by touching them, restoring gravity by releasing her fingers.

abilities.name: Meteor Storm
abilities.description: Floats debris in the air, then releases it to rain down on opponents.

faq.question: What is Uraraka's hero name?
faq.answer: Her hero name is Uravity, which is a portmanteau of her family name Uraraka and gravity.

name: Tomura Shigaraki
description: Tomura Shigaraki, born Tenko Shimura, is the leader of the League of Villains and the primary antagonist of My Hero Academia. He is the grandson of All Might's mentor, Nana Shimura. After accidentally disintegrating his family when his 'Decay' Quirk awakened, Tenko was found and groomed by All For One, who renamed him Tomura Shigaraki. His Quirk allows him to disintegrate anything he touches with all five fingers. Originally childish and temperamental, Tomura grows into a terrifying threat, eventually inheriting All For One's power and body modifications, allowing his Decay to spread across entire cities without direct contact.

abilities.name: Decay Quirk
abilities.description: Disintegrates solid matter on touch, which can chain through connected surfaces.

abilities.name: All For One Quirk
abilities.description: Allows him to steal, wield, and combine multiple quirks from other users.

transformations.name: Masked Form
transformations.description: Wears preserved hands of his family members over his face and body.

transformations.name: Unbound Form
transformations.description: Destroys his masks and sports longer white hair after accepting his destructive nature.

transformations.name: AFO Fused Form
transformations.description: His body adapts with organic armor and growth as All For One attempts to take over.

faq.question: Why does Shigaraki scratch his neck?
faq.answer: Shigaraki's scratching is a psychosomatic reaction to his suppressed trauma and the constant itch caused by his decay quirk before it fully awakened.

name: Armin Arlert
japaneseName: アルミン・アルレルト
description: Armin Arlert is the childhood best friend of Eren Yeager and Mikasa Ackerman, and the 15th Commander of the Survey Corps. While physically weaker than his peers, Armin is a genius strategist whose intelligence and quick thinking have repeatedly saved his squad. He dreams of seeing the sea and exploring the world beyond the walls. During the battle of Shiganshina, Armin sacrificed himself to defeat the Colossal Titan, and was saved by being injected with the Titan serum, consuming Bertholdt Hoover to become the new Colossal Titan. As Eren descends into villainy, Armin leads the Alliance to stop him, choosing diplomacy and peace over violence.

abilities.name: Strategic Genius
abilities.description: Formulates complex plans to identify spies, defeat Titans, and coordinate military campaigns.

abilities.name: Colossal Titan Shifter
abilities.description: Transforms into a 60-meter skinless giant, releasing steam and triggering nuclear-like explosive transformations.

transformations.name: Colossal Titan
transformations.description: A massive 60-meter giant with exposed muscle tissue.

faq.question: Why did Levi choose to save Armin over Erwin?
faq.answer: Levi chose to save Armin because he realized Erwin had become a prisoner of his own dream (proving his father's theory), while Armin looked toward the future with hope. Levi wanted to let Erwin finally rest from the hell of war.

name: Hange Zoe
description: Hange Zoe was the 14th Commander of the Survey Corps, succeeding Erwin Smith. Hange is an eccentric, highly energetic scientist obsessed with researching Titans. Initially viewing Titans with morbid curiosity and empathy (naming her test subjects Sawney and Bean), Hange's research led to the creation of the Thunder Spears, which allowed soldiers to penetrate armored Titans. Behind the manic researcher persona lies a deeply compassionate and intelligent leader. During the Rumbling, Hange sacrificed their life to buy time for the Alliance to escape on their flying boat, single-handedly killing multiple Colossal Titans before succumbing to the extreme heat.

abilities.name: Titan Research & Engineering
abilities.description: Designs military weapons, specialized ODM gear, and traps to capture Titans.

faq.question: What is Hange's gender?
faq.answer: In the manga, creator Hajime Isayama deliberately left Hange's gender ambiguous, instructing publishers to use gender-neutral pronouns. The anime adaptation depicts Hange as female.

name: Reiner Braun
description: Reiner Braun is a Marleyan Warrior and the Armored Titan shifter who infiltrated Paradis Island alongside Bertholdt and Annie. Acting as a dependable older brother figure in the 104th Training Corps, Reiner struggled with a split personality due to the cognitive dissonance between his Marleyan brainwashing and his genuine friendship with the Paradis soldiers. He famously revealed his identity to Eren in a casual conversation on the wall. Haunted by guilt and suicidal ideation post-timeskip, Reiner eventually joins the Alliance to save the world, finding redemption by holding back the Source of All Living Matter during the final battle.

abilities.name: Armored Titan Shifter
abilities.description: Transforms into a 15-meter giant covered in hardened, armor-like plates that resist standard blade strikes.

abilities.name: Military Combat
abilities.description: Highly skilled in hand-to-hand combat and ODM gear tactics.

transformations.name: Armored Titan
transformations.description: A 15-meter giant with hardened skin plates.

faq.question: Why did Reiner develop a split personality?
faq.answer: Reiner developed a split personality as a coping mechanism to deal with the guilt of causing the deaths of thousands of innocent civilians on Paradis, creating a 'soldier' persona who believed he was protecting his friends.

name: Zeke Yeager
description: Zeke Yeager is the warchief of Marley's Warrior Unit and the Beast Titan shifter, as well as the older half-brother of Eren Yeager. Because he has royal Fritz blood through his mother Dina Fritz, Zeke's Beast Titan can create and control Titans using his spinal fluid. Zeke betrayed his parents' restorationist group as a child to survive, and later secretly planned the 'Euthanization Plan' — using the Founding Titan's power to make all Eldians sterile, ending the Titan curse and world conflict through peaceful extinction. He is Levi Ackerman's primary target of vengeance after Zeke decimated the Survey Corps at Shiganshina.

abilities.name: Beast Titan Shifter
abilities.description: Transforms into a 17-meter ape-like giant with long arms, capable of throwing stones with extreme speed and accuracy.

abilities.name: Titan Command
abilities.description: His royal blood allows him to turn Eldians who consumed his spinal fluid into Titans with a scream, controlling their actions.

transformations.name: Beast Titan
transformations.description: A 17-meter ape-like giant with thick brown fur.

faq.question: Why did Zeke want the Euthanization Plan?
faq.answer: Zeke believed that Eldians were born into a world of endless suffering and hatred, and that preventing future Eldians from being born was the most merciful way to end the Titan conflict without mass slaughter.

name: Megumi Fushiguro
description: Megumi Fushiguro is a first-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High and the son of the Sorcerer Killer, Toji Fushiguro. Megumi possesses the Zenin clan's legendary 'Ten Shadows Technique,' which allows him to summon ten distinct shikigami from his shadow, including the near-unbeatable Divine General Mahoraga. Megumi is stoic, analytical, and has a strict moral code, believing that sorcerers should save good people rather than criminals. His potential caught the attention of Ryomen Sukuna, who eventually takes over Megumi's body to use the Ten Shadows to defeat Gojo Satoru.

abilities.name: Ten Shadows Technique
abilities.description: Summons animal-like shikigami from shadows, including Divine Dog, Nue, and Mahoraga.

abilities.name: Chimera Shadow Garden (Domain)
abilities.description: Floods the area with shadow fluid, allowing for infinite shikigami summons and shadow movement.

faq.question: Who is Mahoraga?
faq.answer: Mahoraga (Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga) is the most powerful shikigami in the Ten Shadows. No user in history could tame it. Its ability is to adapt to any attack or phenomenon once hit.

name: Nobara Kugisaki
description: Nobara Kugisaki is a first-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who transferred from the countryside to enjoy city life. Nobara is brash, confident, and fiercely independent, refusing to let anyone define her based on her gender. She fights using the 'Straw Doll Technique,' channeling her cursed energy through a hammer and nails to attack curses from a distance. Her signature move, 'Resonance,' allows her to attack a target's soul directly by driving a nail through a straw doll containing a piece of the target (like hair or blood). During the Shibuya Incident, she was fatally injured by Mahito, leaving her fate ambiguous for a long period.

abilities.name: Straw Doll Technique: Resonance
abilities.description: Attacks a target's soul directly by hitting a connection piece on a straw doll with a cursed nail.

abilities.name: Hairpin
abilities.description: Detonates nails embedded in surroundings to trigger explosive bursts of cursed energy.

faq.question: Does Nobara die in Shibuya?
faq.answer: Mahito used Idle Transfiguration on Nobara's face, destroying her left eye. While she was near death, Arata Nitta stabilized her. Her status was kept secret until the final battle, where she returns to use Resonance on Sukuna's finger.

name: Kento Nanami
description: Kento Nanami is a Grade 1 Jujutsu Sorcerer and a mentor figure to Yuji Itadori. A former salaryman who left jujutsu to work in finance, Nanami returned to sorcery after realizing that both paths are exhausting, but sorcery allows him to directly help others. Nanami is neat, professional, and treats sorcery like a standard office job. He enforces a strict 'Overtime' binding vow that boosts his power when working past normal hours. He fights using his 'Ratio Technique,' which divides his target with lines to create a weak spot at a 7:3 ratio. He was murdered by Mahito during the Shibuya Incident, leaving Yuji with his final words: 'You've got it from here.'

abilities.name: Ratio Technique
abilities.description: Divides the target into a 7:3 ratio, creating a forced weak spot where his attacks deal critical damage.

abilities.name: Overtime
abilities.description: A binding vow that restricts his power to 80% during normal hours, boosting it to 120% when working past his shift.

faq.question: Why did Nanami leave corporate life?
faq.answer: Nanami left corporate life because he found it meaningless. When a bakery worker thanked him for clearing a low-level curse that cured her shoulder pain, he realized his skills had tangible value in helping people, unlike finance.

name: Suguru Geto
description: Suguru Geto was a special grade sorcerer and the former classmate and best friend of Gojo Satoru. Possessing the 'Cursed Spirit Manipulation' technique, Geto could absorb and control curses by consuming them as black spheres. Initially dedicated to protecting non-sorcerers ('monkeys'), the trauma of losing young Riko Amanai and the constant taste of curses broke his sanity. He defected, adopting a fascist ideology to kill all non-sorcerers to end the creation of curses. He was killed by Gojo at the end of Jujutsu Kaisen 0, and his body was later hijacked by Kenjaku to orchestrate the sealing of Gojo.

abilities.name: Cursed Spirit Manipulation
abilities.description: Absorbs curses by swallowing their core, summoning them at will to fight.

abilities.name: Maximum: Uzumaki
abilities.description: Condenses thousands of absorbed curses into a single massive energy beam, extracting their techniques.

faq.question: Who is controlling Geto in the main series?
faq.answer: In the main series, Geto's body is controlled by Kenjaku, an ancient sorcerer who transplants his brain into deceased hosts to inherit their body and cursed techniques.

name: Kurapika
description: Kurapika is the last surviving member of the Kurta clan, who were slaughtered by the Phantom Troupe (Genei Ryodan) for their valuable 'Scarlet Eyes' which turn red when emotional. Kurapika became a Blacklist Hunter to retrieve his clan's stolen eyes and eliminate the Troupe. He is highly intelligent, reserved, and analytical. Kurapika's Nen type is Conjuration, allowing him to create conjured chains on his right hand. When his eyes turn Scarlet, his Nen type shifts to Specialization (Emperor Time), allowing him to master all Nen categories at 100% efficiency, though it drains his lifespan.

abilities.name: Chain Jail
abilities.description: Binds Phantom Troupe members in an unbreakable chain, forcing them into a state of Zetsu. It can only be used on the Troupe.

abilities.name: Emperor Time
abilities.description: Activated when his eyes turn Scarlet, allowing him to use all Nen types at 100% efficiency at the cost of one hour of lifespan per second.

transformations.name: Scarlet Eyes
transformations.description: His eyes glow red, boosting his physical stats and activating Specialization.

faq.question: Why does Kurapika only use Chain Jail on the Phantom Troupe?
faq.answer: Kurapika set a binding vow with a Nen dagger around his heart: if he uses Chain Jail on anyone who is not a member of the Phantom Troupe, the dagger will pierce and kill him instantly. This vow drastically increased the chain's binding power.

name: Leorio Paradinight
japaneseName: レオリオ＝パラディナイト
description: Leorio Paradinight is a member of Gon's core friend group who joined the Hunter Exam to earn money. While initially presenting himself as greedy, Leorio reveals that he wants the wealth to pay for medical school so he can treat poor patients for free, having lost a childhood friend to a treatable disease. Leorio is loud, hot-headed, but deeply loyal and compassionate, acting as the emotional heart of the group. His Nen type is Emission, allowing him to punch the ground and project his fist from a portal elsewhere, which he famously used to punch Ging Freecss in the face for neglecting Gon.

abilities.name: Remote Punch
abilities.description: Emits his fist through surfaces to strike targets from a distance.

faq.question: What is Leorio's current role in Hunter x Hunter?
faq.answer: Leorio becomes a member of the Hunter Association's Zodiacs (under the code name 'Boar') and travels to the Dark Continent as a medical doctor.

name: Hisoka Morow
description: Hisoka Morow is a magician and former member of the Phantom Troupe who acts as a wildcard antagonist in Hunter x Hunter. Hisoka is a sociopath who is obsessed with finding and fighting strong opponents, getting physical pleasure from bloodlust. He spares young Gon and Killua during the exams because he wants to wait for them to grow strong enough to be worth killing. Hisoka's Nen type is Transmutation, allowing him to use 'Bungee Gum' — which possesses the properties of both rubber and gum — to pull, bind, and deflect objects in combat, and 'Texture Surprise' to alter surfaces to deceive opponents.

abilities.name: Bungee Gum
abilities.description: Transmutes his aura to have properties of both rubber and gum, allowing it to stretch, contract, and stick to targets.

abilities.name: Texture Surprise
abilities.description: Applies a paper-thin layer of aura to objects to make them appear like any texture, including skin, paper, or text.

faq.question: Did you know that Bungee Gum has the properties of both rubber and gum?
faq.answer: Yes, Hisoka repeats this phrase frequently. Its elastic properties allow him to deflect bullets, slingshot himself, and pull opponents into his range.

name: Chrollo Lucilfer
description: Chrollo Lucilfer is the founder and leader of the Phantom Troupe, a notorious band of thieves from Meteor City. Chrollo is an intellectual, calm, and ruthless leader who commands absolute loyalty from his members. His Nen type is Specialization, and he carries a conjured book called 'Skill Hunter' (Bandit's Secret), which allows him to steal other Nen users' abilities after fulfilling strict conditions, using them as his own. Chrollo is a master of combat tactics, capable of holding off both Zeno and Silva Zoldyck simultaneously, and later defeating Hisoka in a death match at Heavens Arena.

abilities.name: Skill Hunter (Bandit's Secret)
abilities.description: A conjured book that stores stolen Nen abilities. He must hold the book open to use the stolen technique.

abilities.name: Double Face (Bookmark)
abilities.description: A bookmark that allows Chrollo to use an ability from a bookmarked page even when the book is closed, or use two abilities simultaneously.

faq.question: What is Chrollo's connection to Meteor City?
faq.answer: Chrollo was born in Meteor City, a junkyard city not recognized by any nation, whose citizens have no official identity records. His desire to give the city a voice and steal from the world inspired the creation of the Phantom Troupe.

name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
description: Zenitsu Agatsuma is a Demon Slayer who traveled alongside Tanjiro Kamado. Zenitsu is a coward who frequently cries, screams, and claims he is going to die on missions, begging girls to marry him. However, when he passes out from extreme fear, his subconscious takes over, allowing him to execute Thunder Breathing techniques with blinding speed. He only mastered the first form, 'Thunderclap and Flash,' but refined it to be faster than lightning, eventually developing his own Seventh Form (Flaming Thunder God) to defeat his former senior disciple Kaigaku, who had turned into a demon.

abilities.name: Thunder Breathing: First Form
abilities.description: Thunderclap and Flash — A quick-draw slash executed at god-like speed, which Zenitsu can chain together (Six Fold, Eight Fold).

abilities.name: Seventh Form: Flaming Thunder God
abilities.description: Zenitsu's original technique, conjuring a massive lightning dragon that cuts through enemies instantly.

transformations.name: Sleeping Form
transformations.description: Passes out, allowing his body to move unconsciously with maximum speed.

faq.question: Why is Zenitsu's hair blonde?
faq.answer: Zenitsu was originally born with black hair, but it turned golden-yellow after he was struck by lightning while hiding in a tree during his training.

name: Inosuke Hashibira
description: Inosuke Hashibira is a Demon Slayer who wears a hollowed-out wild boar head to hide his surprisingly feminine face. Raised by wild boars in the mountains, Inosuke is loud, aggressive, and lives to compete and fight, constantly challenging Tanjiro. He uses a self-taught combat style called 'Beast Breathing,' wielding two serrated, chipped katana. Inosuke is extremely flexible, capable of dislocating his joints at will to squeeze through narrow tunnels or reposition his internal organs to avoid fatal strikes. He develops a deep bond with Tanjiro and Zenitsu, learning human empathy through their journeys.

abilities.name: Beast Breathing
abilities.description: Aggressive, animal-like slashes using chipped dual swords, emphasizing raw power.

abilities.name: Spatial Awareness
abilities.description: By stabbing his swords into the ground, he can detect vibrations to locate enemies miles away.

transformations.name: Boar Mask
transformations.description: Wears his signature wild boar mask.

transformations.name: Unmasked Form
transformations.description: Reveals his beautiful, doll-like face.

faq.question: Why are Inosuke's swords chipped?
faq.answer: Inosuke uses a rock to chip the edges of his dual katana manually because he prefers the jagged, tearing cuts they make, which resemble wild animal claws.

name: Kyojuro Rengoku
description: Kyojuro Rengoku was the Flame Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps and the main character of the Mugen Train arc. Kyojuro was loud, cheerful, and possessed an unyielding moral compass taught to him by his late mother: those born strong have a duty to protect the weak. Wielding Flame Breathing, Kyojuro protected all 200 passengers on the Mugen Train from Enmu. When Upper Moon 3 Akaza arrived, Kyojuro fought him in a duel, refusing Akaza's offer to turn him into a demon. Despite receiving fatal injuries, Kyojuro kept Akaza pinned until sunrise, dying with a smile on his face, having successfully saved every human passenger and inspiring Tanjiro to grow stronger.

abilities.name: Flame Breathing
abilities.description: Aggressive, sweeping fire slashes that mimic the intensity of fire.

abilities.name: Ninth Form: Rengoku
abilities.description: A devastating charging strike that carves a deep trench in the ground, wrapping the user in a fire dragon.

faq.question: What were Rengoku's final words to Tanjiro?
faq.answer: Rengoku told Tanjiro to 'set your heart ablaze' (Kokoro o Moyase) and trust in the path he chose, passing on a message for his brother Senjuro and his father.

name: Muzan Kibutsuji
description: Muzan Kibutsuji is the Demon Progenitor and the primary antagonist of Demon Slayer. He became the first demon over a thousand years ago during the Heian period after a doctor treated his fatal illness with a blue spider lily medicine. Muzan created all other demons using his blood, which allows him to control their thoughts, see their locations, and execute them remotely through a curse. He is narcissistic, cold, and cowardly, obsessed with finding the blue spider lily or a demon who can conquer sunlight to achieve true immortality. He is responsible for slaughtering Tanjiro's family and turning Nezuko into a demon.

abilities.name: Demon Blood Transfusion
abilities.description: Injects his blood into humans to turn them into powerful demons, or melts their cells if injected in large quantities.

abilities.name: Biokinesis & Shape-Shifting
abilities.description: Can alter his form, age, gender, and sprout whipping barbed tentacles from his body.

transformations.name: Human Disguises
transformations.description: Shifts between a businessman, a woman, and a sick child.

transformations.name: Combat Form
transformations.description: Covered in mouths and wielding red whip-like tentacles.

transformations.name: Giant Baby Form
transformations.description: A massive flesh baby shell used to protect his body from sunlight.

faq.question: Why does Muzan fear Tanjiro's earrings?
faq.answer: Tanjiro wears Hanafuda earrings that belonged to Yoriichi Tsugikuni, the Sun Breathing swordsman who defeated Muzan 400 years ago, leaving him with scars that never healed.

name: Aki Hayakawa
description: Aki Hayakawa is a Public Safety Devil Hunter working under Makima's division. Aki is driven by a desire for vengeance against the Gun Devil, who slaughtered his family when he was a child. Initially cold and resentful of Denji's presence, Aki gradually forms a deep, brotherly bond with Denji and Power, renting an apartment with them. Aki has contracts with the Fox Devil, the Curse Devil (wielding a nail sword that cuts off lifespans), and eventually the Future Devil, who grants him the ability to see seconds into the future. His story ends in tragedy when he is killed and possessed by the Gun Devil, forcing Denji to kill him in a snowball fight hallucination.

abilities.name: Curse Devil Contract
abilities.description: By stabbing enemies three times with his nail sword, he summons the Curse Devil to crush them in exchange for years of his lifespan.

abilities.name: Future Devil Contract
abilities.description: Allows Aki to see two seconds into the future to react to attacks.

transformations.name: Gun Fiend Form
transformations.description: His body is taken over by the Gun Devil, with an M16 rifle barrel emerging from his face.

faq.question: Why did the Future Devil give Aki a contract for free?
faq.answer: The Future Devil gave Aki the contract in exchange for living in his right eye because he saw that Aki would suffer 'the worst possible death,' and wanted to witness it firsthand.

name: Ryuk
description: Ryuk is a Shinigami (God of Death) who, bored with the barren Shinigami Realm, deliberately dropped his Death Note into the human world to see what would happen. He is the constant companion of Light Yagami, who finds the notebook. Ryuk is a neutral observer, refusing to help Light or L, and openly stating that he will be the one to write Light's name in his notebook when Light's time comes. He has a severe addiction to human apples, experiencing withdrawal symptoms (like twisting his body) if he goes without them. His unique design features a stitch-mouth smile, large eyes, and feathered wings.

abilities.name: Death Note
abilities.description: Writing a human's name in this notebook causes them to die within 40 seconds of a heart attack or specified cause.

abilities.name: Shinigami Eyes
abilities.description: Allows him to see any human's name and remaining lifespan above their head, which he can trade to humans for half their remaining life.

faq.question: Why did Ryuk write Light's name in the end?
faq.answer: Ryuk wrote Light's name because Light was defeated and captured, and Ryuk didn't want to wait around for Light to die in prison. He followed his promise that he would be the one to write Light's name when it was over.

name: Misa Amane
description: Misa Amane is a famous model and actress who becomes the 'Second Kira' after obtaining a Death Note from the Shinigami Rem. Misa is deeply devoted to Light Yagami, who she fell in love with after Kira executed the robber who murdered her parents. Misa is cheerful, childish, and hyperactive, but shows a ruthless side, killing anyone Light requests. She made the Shinigami Eye deal twice, cutting her lifespan in half twice, to help Light defeat L. Light manipulates her love to use her as a tool, and Rem eventually sacrifices her life to protect Misa from L's trap.

abilities.name: Shinigami Eyes
abilities.description: Traded half her lifespan to see names and lifespans above anyone's head instantly.

faq.question: What happens to Misa in the end?
faq.answer: After Light's death, Misa becomes depressed. Although not shown in detail in the anime, it is heavily implied that she committed suicide on Valentine's Day in 2011, shortly after Light died.
